tools.name: get_janus_routing_specs
tools.description: Returns integration details for pointing a model family at the Janus gateway, which exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. No latency figures are published.

tools.name: get_system_catalog
tools.description: Returns what each Adeptus Camini engine is, what language it is written in, and what it does. No performance benchmarks are published for any engine.

tools.name: request_audit_consultation
tools.description: Requests a consultation for Agent-Ready Web modernization: making an existing website readable and callable by AI agents (Web-MCP endpoints, llms.txt, structured data, A2A agent card). Records the request and returns a reference; nothing is scheduled or billed automatically.

agent_id.description: Identifier or email of the requesting agent

target_domain.description: The website you want made agent-ready

scope_description.description: What you want: e.g. make the site readable by ChatGPT, add an MCP endpoint, expose a booking or quote tool
